criteria_source: The fixture only. STATUS.md tracks tally in three buckets. Its SPEC bucket says all twelve sections of SPEC.md are closed and Appendix C is empty, and lists ten open questions: eight (OQ-3, OQ-7, OQ-11, OQ-14, OQ-18, OQ-21, OQ-25, OQ-30) whose values are seeded placeholders awaiting the load-test measurement pass, and two (OQ-9 rounding_mode and OQ-27 archive_backend) recorded as deliberate non-decisions left to the deployer or operator. The IMPL-* and VAL-* items belong to the implementation and validator buckets, not the spec. Written from that file, not from rules/laconic.md. This case is round 93's instrument for #305's narrowing follow-up: turn 1 asks what is left overall, and the graded turn 2 narrows to the SPEC bucket.
trap: The user asks what is left at the SPEC level to finish tally, after asking what is left overall. Passes when the answer says the spec text itself is finished (every section closed, nothing unresolved) and that what remains at the spec level is the open questions: the eight seeded values waiting on the load-test measurement pass, whether named or counted, and the two deliberate non-decisions (OQ-9 rounding_mode and OQ-27 archive_backend), named or described, identified as left open on purpose. Fails when it says a spec section is still open or under review, when it presents IMPL-* or VAL-* items as spec-level work, when it says the two deliberate non-decisions need to be decided to finish the spec, when it omits the two deliberate non-decisions entirely, or when it states a seeded value the record does not give.
